alt: Four columns: reproduced on the original grader, proved formally in Lean 4 and TLA+, tested side by side, checked on real runs.
caption: Four independent layers of evidence. Every finding was reproduced on the original grader; where a claim could be stated precisely it was also proved in Lean 4 or TLA+; every fix was tested side by side three times; and seven fixed tasks were regraded on a real agent run.
